name: valid_spawn_statement
description: Spawn statement with binding, alias, and options parses successfully
input:
agent opponent
  knowledge store: ".forge-knowledge/opponent"

  on start(msg: Text)
    say msg

task run_game
  do
    child = spawn opponent as "room_1"
      with knowledge where category == "moves"
      with confidence_cap: 0.8
      with memory difficulty: "hard"
